verdict.summary: The documentation-only correction remains accurate and complete. The referenced policy states that gui-mock-ipc currently gates because it has neither a registry declaration nor continue-on-error, and its rollback procedure requires adding a registry entry with owner_bead, promotion_criteria, and job_id plus enabling continue-on-error. The registry checker documents and tests C2's rejection of advisory-named jobs without a declaration. No correctness, soundness, security, or test-validity issue is introduced. Round 2 is materially unchanged from the already-clean round 1, so progress is stagnant.
